annotations.text:
A — Instrument Panel
Dark, phosphor-amber accent, hairline-bordered card. Hardware measurement-panel feel — closest match to the planned voice-orb aesthetic.

B — Signal Editorial
Light, single electric-indigo accent, no boxed card — hairline rules and generous type instead. Refined, document-like precision.

C — Terminal Native
Pure black, monospace throughout, bracketed labels, subtle scanline. The most literal/raw take on the technical direction.

D — between A and B
Light + airy like B (Space Grotesk headline, bordered-but-open card) with A's technical chrome: IBM Plex Mono for all data/labels, warm muted ochre accent instead of A's amber or B's indigo.
